model.name: Elo-MoV + pace-total, walk-forward

elo.source: structure follows FTE-ELO; parameters are the literature values

components.spread: model_margin = a + b*elo_diff, a,b from expanding OLS on prior seasons
components.total: exp-weighted (half-life 6 games) team scoring, OLS recalibrated on prior seasons
components.moneyline: P(home win)=Phi(model_margin/sigma), sigma from walk-forward residuals

model.no_lookahead: ratings/form are updated only after a game has been scored; calibration coefficients use only seasons strictly before the game's season
